recipe: Recorded once with python3 -I (C scanner): each row's 'in' went through json.loads(in). 'out' is the result as type-tagged JSON (null, bool, int as decimal text, float as repr(), str, list, dict as [key, value] pairs in insertion order); 'err' is the exception class with msg/pos/lineno/colno and str(); 'lone_surrogate' marks a result holding a lone surrogate (the Go port refuses it with ErrLoneSurrogate); 'too_deep' marks rows nested deeper than 200 (the Go port refuses them with ErrJSONTooDeep, whatever Python did). Corpus: hand-picked edge cases plus 500 seeded random mutations (random.Random(20261021)) of one small document. The recorder script was throwaway and is not kept. Recorded on Python 3.14.7 (the version CI ran the ported scripts on) and on 3.12.3; a row whose 3.12.3 result differs keeps it in py312 (LoadsJSON follows 3.14.7).
